items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1976-02-04
items.q: Dr. Jazz and Willie the Weeper, all them things were tunes that were Native American with a flair of the field and the, and the voice of what people in America did.

ctx.x: Strutting With Some Barbecue, uh, and then the Fats Waller tune and Amos Behem, What Did I Do To Be So Black and Blue, and, uh, Dr. Jazz and Willie the Weeper, all them things were tunes that were Native American with a flair of the field and the, and the voice of what people in America did. See, Vicks had another thing going.
